examples.en: You should drink some water and have a rest.
examples.zh: 你应该喝点水，休息一下。

examples.en: Maybe you should see a doctor.
We need to eat healthy food.
examples.zh: 我们需要吃健康的食物。

grammar.pattern: I'm going to ... / ... is going to ...
grammar.rule: 用 be going to 加动词原形，表示打算或计划做某事。

examples.en: I'm going to the science museum tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要去科学博物馆。

examples.en: My mum is going to take me to hospital this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午我妈妈要带我去医院。

grammar.rule: 用动词的过去式或 was/were 来说过去发生的事情。

examples.en: My good friend Lucy moved to another city.
examples.zh: 我好朋友露西搬到了另一个城市。

examples.en: Miss White asked her, "What's the matter, Liu Jia?"
examples.zh: 怀特老师问她：“刘佳，怎么了？”

grammar.rule: 用 be 加动词的 -ing 形式，表示正在发生的动作或状态。

grammar.point: be going to 表示计划/打算
grammar.pattern: I'm going to ... / She is going to ... / He is going to ...
grammar.rule: 用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形，表示打算做某事。

examples.en: I'm going to buy a schoolbag.
She is going to buy a new schoolbag.
Mike is going to save up for a computer.
examples.zh: 迈克打算攒钱买一台电脑。

examples.en: I'm going to buy ... And I also want to buy ...

grammar.point: want to do 表示想要做某事
grammar.pattern: I want to ... / She wants to ...
grammar.rule: 用 want to 加动词原形，表示想要做某事。

examples.en: I also want to buy some animal books.
She wants to buy a new schoolbag.
He also wants to buy a robot show ticket.
examples.zh: 他还想买一张机器人展的票。

grammar.rule: need 后面可以直接加名词，也可以用 need to 加动词原形。

examples.en: Yes, you need a new one.

grammar.point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
grammar.pattern: She writes ... / She gets ... / She keeps ...
grammar.rule: 主语是 he/she/it 时，动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: She writes a spending plan every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她每个星期天写一份消费计划。

examples.en: Every week, she gets her pocket money.
examples.zh: 每周，她都会得到零花钱。

examples.en: She keeps her money in three money jars.
examples.zh: 她把钱放在三个存钱罐里。

examples.en: She uses this money to buy goods, like books.
examples.zh: 她用这笔钱买商品，比如书。

grammar.point: use ... to do 表示用……来做某事
grammar.pattern: We use money to ... / She uses this money to ...
grammar.rule: use 后面加名词，再用 to 加动词原形，表示用某物做某事。

examples.en: We use money to buy goods.
We use money to pay for services.
She uses this money to buy goods, like books.
examples.zh: 她用这笔钱买商品，比如书。

examples.en: She also uses it to pay for services, like haircuts.
examples.zh: 她还用它来支付服务，比如理发。

grammar.point: There was 表示过去存在
grammar.rule: 用 There was 表示过去有某样东西。

examples.en: There was shell money, knife money, copper coins, ...

grammar.rule: 描述过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: I visited the "Gingerbread House" last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我上个星期六去参观“姜饼屋”了。

examples.en: I went to Xi'an with my family.
We went to see the Terracotta Warriors.

grammar.pattern: What/Where/How + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
grammar.rule: 用 did 提问过去的事情，后面的动词要用原形。

examples.en: Where did you go over the summer holidays, Binbin?

examples.zh: 你们在那儿做了些什么？

grammar.point: 一般过去时的一般疑问句
grammar.pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...? Yes, 主语 + did. / No, 主语 + didn't.
grammar.rule: 用 Did 开头提问，回答也用 did 或 didn't。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数 + ...
grammar.rule: 描述经常发生或现在的情况，主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: My head hurts and I have a runny nose.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
examples.zh: 中国航天员很早就起床。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can + 动词原形 + ...
grammar.rule: can 表示“能、会”，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: What can you see in the sky?
examples.zh: 你能在天空中看到什么？

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
examples.zh: 在晚上，我们能看到月亮和星星。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should + 动词原形 + ...
grammar.rule: should 表示“应该”，后面跟动词原形。

examples.en: Maybe you should see a doctor.
We should use air conditioners less.

grammar.point: 询问与回答“能看到什么”
grammar.pattern: What can you see ...? / I can see ...
grammar.rule: 用 can 表示“能够看到”，后面接看到的事物。

examples.en: What can you see in the sky?
examples.zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

examples.en: I can see buildings, a river, ...
examples.zh: 我能看到建筑物、一条河……

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
examples.zh: 在夜晚，我们能看到月亮和星星。

grammar.point: There be 句型（单数/复数）
grammar.rule: 用 There is 表示“有”单数事物，用 There are 表示“有”复数事物。

examples.en: There are large oceans on Earth.
There isn't any life on it.

grammar.point: 一般现在时（描述事实与习惯）
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形 / 动词第三人称单数形式
grammar.rule: 用一般现在时描述客观事实或经常发生的事情。

examples.en: Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球是一颗行星。它绕着太阳转。

examples.en: The Moon is my neighbour. It travels around me too.
examples.zh: 月亮是我的邻居。它也绕着我转。

examples.en: The Sun gives us light and keeps us warm.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning.
examples.zh: 航天员们早上很早起床。

grammar.point: 情态动词 can 表能力
grammar.pattern: 主语 + can + 动词原形
grammar.rule: 用 can 表示“能够做某事”。

examples.en: We can see the Sun and clouds.
We can also see birds and planes.
examples.zh: 我们还能看到鸟和飞机。

examples.en: We can look into space with telescopes.
examples.zh: 我们可以用望远镜观察太空。

examples.en: They can't use water to wash their faces.

grammar.point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
grammar.pattern: 主语（单数）+ 动词加 s/es
grammar.rule: 主语是单数时，动词要加 s 或 es。

examples.en: It gives us light and keeps us warm.
It talks about things on Mars.
examples.zh: 它讲的是火星上的事物。

examples.en: It has a temperature of about 467°C.
examples.zh: 它的温度大约是467摄氏度。

grammar.point: 疑问句：Is there any ...? / Are there any ...?
grammar.pattern: Is there any ...? / Are there any ...?
grammar.rule: 用 Is there any 询问单数事物是否存在，用 Are there any 询问复数事物是否存在。

examples.en: Is there any water on Mars?
Is there any life on the Sun?
Are there any ... around the Sun?

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 → 过去式（如 go → went, have → had）
grammar.rule: 有些动词变过去式时不按规则加 -ed，要单独记住它们的过去式形式。

grammar.point: 情态动词 should 表建议
grammar.rule: 用 should 加动词原形，表示“我们应该做某事”，用来提出建议。

examples.en: We should always unplug our computers and TVs.
examples.zh: 我们应该总是拔掉电脑和电视的插头。

examples.en: We should use air conditioners less.

grammar.point: 情态动词 can 表能力或建议
grammar.rule: 用 can 加动词原形，表示“我们可以做某事”，用来提出可行的做法。

examples.en: We can also use LED lighting.
We can go by bus or walk to ...
examples.zh: 我们可以坐公交车或步行去……
我们可以重复使用旧瓶子。

grammar.point: 一般现在时（第三人称单数）
grammar.rule: 主语是第三人称单数时，疑问句用 does 开头，动词用原形。

examples.en: What does Binbin want to know about it?
examples.zh: 彬彬想知道关于它的什么？

examples.en: How much fresh water does Earth have?

grammar.rule: 主语是 we/they 等复数时，动词用原形，表示经常或一般的情况。

examples.en: We use electricity to run a car, light a bulb, heat a room and cool a house.
examples.zh: 我们用电力来开车、点亮灯泡、加热房间和冷却房屋。

examples.en: We use green energy to light, heat and cool our homes and schools.
examples.zh: 我们用绿色能源来照明、加热和冷却我们的家和学校。

examples.en: We also use it to run cars, buses and trains.
examples.zh: 我们也用它来运行汽车、公交车和火车。

grammar.rule: 用 was/were 或动词过去式表示过去发生的事情。

examples.en: What did they choose for their project?
examples.zh: 他们为项目选择了什么？

grammar.rule: 用 There is/are 表示“有……”，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。

examples.en: There are many resources running out.

grammar.rule: 用 is/are 加动词的 -ing 形式，表示正在发生的动作。

examples.en: These people are having fun on the farm.
examples.zh: 这些人在农场玩得很开心。

grammar.rule: 用动词的过去式表示过去发生的事情。

examples.en: Saturday was a busy day for me.
examples.zh: 星期六对我来说是忙碌的一天。

examples.en: In the morning, I got up early.
What did Mike do on the farm?

grammar.rule: 用 will 加动词原形表示将来要做的事。

examples.en: Bill will wear a red hat to work.
examples.zh: 比尔上班时会戴一顶红帽子。

examples.en: We will draw pictures and sing songs.
We will also give many prizes to our good students.
examples.zh: 我们还会给优秀学生们发很多奖品。

grammar.rule: 用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形表示计划或打算做某事。

examples.en: We are going to have a farewell party.
examples.zh: 我们要举办一场告别派对。

examples.en: We are going to give prizes for the best pictures.
examples.zh: 我们会为最好的画颁发奖品。

grammar.pattern: A is bigger/smaller than B; A is the biggest/smallest
grammar.rule: 用比较级加 than 表示两者比较，用 the 加最高级表示三者及以上比较。

examples.en: Is this bigger or smaller than the elephant?
I think it’s bigger than the elephant.
So the whale is the biggest, and the tiger is the smallest.
examples.zh: 所以鲸鱼是最大的，老虎是最小的。

grammar.rule: 用 There is/are 表示某处有某物。

grammar.pattern: How tall are you? / How tall is it?
grammar.rule: 用 How tall 来问人或物有多高，回答用 I’m ... metres 或 It’s ... metres。

grammar.pattern: How heavy are you? / How heavy is it?
grammar.rule: 用 How heavy 来问人或物有多重，回答用 I’m ... kilograms 或 It’s ... tons。
用 What size 来问鞋子的尺码，回答用 My shoes are size ... 或 Size ...。

examples.en: In China I wear size 40 shoes.

grammar.rule: 用形容词的比较级加 than 来比较两个人或物，比如 taller than, heavier than, older than。

examples.en: It’s taller than both of us together.
examples.zh: 它比我们两个加起来还高。

examples.en: Your feet are bigger than mine.

grammar.rule: 用 There is 或 There are 来说某处有某物，is 用于单数，are 用于复数。

examples.en: There are more dinosaurs over there!

grammar.rule: 用 How old 来问年龄，回答用 I’m ... years old。
用 is 加形容词的比较级，再用 than 和另一个对象作比较。

examples.en: My small cat is smaller than yours.
My big dog is bigger than yours.
Now I am taller, taller than before.
Once I was a young boy, younger than I am today.
examples.zh: 我曾经是个小男孩，比今天的我更年轻。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（行为动词过去式）
grammar.rule: 表示过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式。

examples.en: Last weekend I went to the zoo.
I saw a film and played ping-pong.
examples.zh: 我看了一场电影，还打了乒乓球。

examples.en: I bought a gift for you.

grammar.point: 一般过去时疑问句（What did you do?）
grammar.pattern: What did you do + 时间?
grammar.rule: 用 What did you do 来问别人过去做了什么，后面加时间。

examples.en: What did you do last weekend?
What did you do last night?

grammar.point: 一般过去时一般疑问句（Did you ...?）
grammar.rule: 用 Did you 开头问过去有没有做某事，后面动词用原形。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + didn't + 动词原形 + ...
grammar.rule: 用 didn't 表示过去没有做某事，后面动词用原形。

examples.en: I didn't see a big round stone.
examples.zh: 我没有看到一块又大又圆的石头。

examples.en: Once I didn't talk a lot.

grammar.point: 一般现在时（描述现在状态）
grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 形容词/比较级
grammar.rule: 用 am/is/are 加形容词来说明现在的样子或状态。

examples.en: Now I am taller, taller than before.
Now I am a big boy, and I'm bigger every day.
examples.zh: 现在我是个大小伙子了，而且每天都更大。

grammar.rule: 表示过去发生的事情，规则动词一般在词尾加 -ed，如 talk→talked, stay→stayed, live→lived, want→wanted, plan→planned, cry→cried。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
grammar.rule: 有些动词的过去式要特殊记，如 saw, slept, had, went, fell, hurt。

examples.en: I fell off my bike and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 我从自行车上摔下来，弄伤了脚。

grammar.pattern: How was your weekend? / It was ...
grammar.rule: 用 How was your weekend? 问对方周末过得怎么样，回答用 It was + 形容词。

grammar.pattern: What did you do (last weekend / yesterday / ...)?
grammar.rule: 用 What did you do? 问过去做了什么，回答用 I + 动词过去式。

examples.en: What did you do last weekend?
I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.
examples.zh: 我打扫了房间，洗了衣服。

examples.en: I stayed at home and watched TV.

grammar.pattern: Did you ...? Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
grammar.rule: 用 Did 开头问过去的事情，回答用 Yes, I did. 或 No, I didn't.。

examples.en: Did you play football with Zhang Peng?
Did you like it? Yes, I did.
examples.zh: 你喜欢它吗？是的，我喜欢。

grammar.point: 时间状语：last weekend / yesterday / last night
grammar.pattern: ... last weekend / yesterday / last night / last Monday / the day before yesterday
grammar.rule: 这些词表示过去的时间，常和一般过去时一起用。

examples.en: I cleaned my room and washed my clothes on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我星期六打扫了房间，洗了衣服。

examples.en: I had a cold. I stayed at home all weekend and slept.
examples.zh: 我感冒了。整个周末我待在家里睡觉。

grammar.rule: 表示过去发生的事情，动词要变成过去式，很多动词加 -ed。

examples.en: I went to a forest park.

grammar.point: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 不规则动词过去式 + ...
grammar.rule: 有些动词的过去式要特殊记，比如 go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, hurt→hurt。

examples.en: I saw lots of grapes and ate lots of mutton kebabs.
examples.zh: 我看到了很多葡萄，吃了很多羊肉串。

examples.en: I fell off my bike last Saturday and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 上周六我从自行车上摔下来，弄伤了脚。

examples.en: We saw lots of grapes there.
examples.zh: 我们在那里看到了很多葡萄。

examples.en: I went swimming every weekend and took lots of pictures.
examples.zh: 我每个周末都去游泳，还拍了很多照片。

grammar.pattern: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
grammar.rule: 问过去的事情用 Did 开头，后面的动词用原形。

grammar.point: 一般过去时肯定回答（Yes, I/we did.）
grammar.pattern: Yes, 主语 + did. / No, 主语 + didn't.
grammar.rule: 回答 Did 开头的问题，用 Yes, ... did. 或 No, ... didn't.。

grammar.point: 询问过去地点（Where did you go?）
grammar.pattern: Where did you go (over your holiday / last Saturday)?
grammar.rule: 问别人过去去了哪里，用 Where did you go? 后面可以加时间。

examples.en: Where did you go over your holiday?
Where did you go last Saturday?
Where did you go over the winter holiday?

grammar.point: 询问过去交通方式（How did you go there?）
grammar.pattern: How did you go there? / By + 交通工具
grammar.rule: 问过去怎么去的地方，用 How did you go there? 回答用 By + 交通工具。

grammar.point: There was / There were 句型
grammar.rule: 用 There was 表示过去有单数或不可数名词，用 There were 表示过去有复数名词。

examples.en: There was only one small building on a hill.
There were no computers or Internet in my time.
examples.zh: 我那时候没有电脑，也没有互联网。

examples.en: There were many trees, and there were many clean rivers.
examples.zh: 那时有很多树，还有很多干净的河流。

grammar.point: 一般过去时否定句 didn't + 动词原形
grammar.rule: 用 didn't 加动词原形，表示过去没有做某事或没有某物。

examples.en: We didn't have a library, and there weren't any computer rooms at all.
examples.zh: 我们没有图书馆，也完全没有电脑室。
那时人们不能用互联网。

grammar.point: 一般过去时 be 动词 was / were
grammar.rule: 单数用 was，复数用 were，表示过去的状态。

examples.en: Before, I was quiet. Now, I'm very active in class.
examples.zh: 以前我很安静。现在我在课堂上很活跃。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前很矮，所以骑不好自行车。

grammar.point: 情态动词 could / couldn't 表过去能力
grammar.rule: 用 could 表示过去能做某事，用 couldn't 表示过去不能做某事。

examples.en: Could you see stars at night?
Grandpa could use computers when he was at school.
I couldn't ride my bike well.

grammar.point: 一般将来时 will + 动词原形
grammar.rule: 用 will 加动词原形，表示将来会发生的事。

examples.en: In 2050, there will be house robots.
They will cook, clean and wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 它们会做饭、打扫和洗碗。

examples.en: If we change now, whales and humans will have a bright future.
examples.zh: 如果我们现在改变，鲸鱼和人类都会有光明的未来。

examples.en: We should help the earth now, so birds will have homes and the forests will be healthy and green again.
examples.zh: 我们现在应该帮助地球，这样鸟儿就会有家园，森林也会重新变得健康又绿。

grammar.point: 情态动词 should 表建议
grammar.rule: 用 should 加动词原形，表示应该做某事。

examples.en: We should help the earth now, so birds will have homes and the forests will be healthy and green again.
examples.zh: 我们现在应该帮助地球，这样鸟儿就会有家园，森林也会重新变得健康又绿。

grammar.pattern: That's the + 最高级形容词 + 名词 + in ...
grammar.rule: 用 the 加最高级形容词，表示在某个范围内最……

examples.en: That's the tallest dinosaur in this hall.
examples.zh: 那是这个厅里最高的恐龙。

grammar.pattern: It's + 比较级形容词 + than ...
grammar.rule: 用比较级形容词加 than，表示比……更……

examples.en: It's taller than both of us together.
Your feet are bigger than mine.

grammar.pattern: How tall are you? I'm ... metres.
grammar.rule: 用 How tall 询问身高，回答用 I'm 加数字和 metres

grammar.pattern: What size are your shoes? My shoes are size ...
grammar.rule: 用 What size 询问鞋码，回答用 size 加数字

examples.en: What size are your shoes, Mike?

grammar.pattern: How heavy are you? I'm ... kilograms.
grammar.rule: 用 How heavy 询问体重，回答用 I'm 加数字和 kilograms
表示过去发生的事情，动词要用过去式

examples.en: I stayed at home with your grandma.
We drank tea in the afternoon and watched TV.
examples.zh: 我们喝了下午茶，还看了电视。

examples.en: I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.
examples.zh: 我打扫了房间，还洗了衣服。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（did 疑问句与回答）
grammar.pattern: Did you ...? Yes, we did. / No, we didn't.
grammar.rule: 用 Did 开头问过去做过的事，回答用 Yes, ... did. 或 No, ... didn't.

grammar.point: 一般过去时（where 疑问句）
grammar.rule: 用 Where did you go? 问过去去了哪里。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（how 疑问句与交通方式）
grammar.pattern: How did you go there? We went there by ...
grammar.rule: 用 How did you go there? 问过去怎么去的，回答用 went ... by + 交通工具。
用 There was/were no ... 表示过去没有某物。

examples.en: There was no library in my old school.
examples.zh: 我以前的学校里没有图书馆。

examples.en: There were no computers or Internet in my time.
examples.zh: 我那时候没有电脑也没有网络。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（was/were 描述过去状态）
grammar.rule: 用 I was ... 描述过去是什么样。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前个子小，自行车骑得不好。

grammar.point: 情态动词 couldn't（过去不能）
grammar.rule: 用 couldn't 表示过去不能做某事。

examples.en: I was short, so I couldn't ride my bike well.
examples.zh: 我以前个子小，自行车骑得不好。

grammar.pattern: Where are you going? / I'm going to ...
grammar.rule: 用 Where are you going? 问别人要去哪里，回答用 I'm going to + 地点。

examples.en: Little Red-Cap: I'm going to my grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 小红帽：我要去我奶奶家。

grammar.pattern: What for? / I am going to ... with it/them.
grammar.rule: 用 What for? 问用途，回答用 I am going to + 动词 + with it/them 表示打算用某物做某事。

examples.zh: 稻草卖家：当然。用来做什么？

examples.en: Pete: I am going to build a house with it.
examples.zh: 皮特：我打算用它盖一座房子。

examples.en: Pat: I am going to build a house with them.
examples.zh: 帕特：我打算用它们盖一座房子。

examples.en: Paul: I am going to build a house with them.
examples.zh: 保罗：我打算用它们盖一座房子。

grammar.point: 一般过去时（叙述过去发生的事）
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式（如 left, met, built, came, went, saw, ate, killed）
grammar.rule: 讲过去发生的事情时，动词要用过去式，比如 left, met, built, came, went, saw, ate, killed。

examples.en: One day, they left their mother's house.
examples.zh: 有一天，他们离开了妈妈的家。

examples.en: One day, Pete met a man.
examples.zh: 有一天，皮特遇到了一个人。

examples.en: So Pete built his house of straw.
examples.zh: 于是皮特用稻草盖了他的房子。

examples.en: The wolf blew the straw house down.

grammar.point: 一般现在时（描述习惯或事实）
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数形式（如 is, are, live, help, sing）
grammar.rule: 说现在的事实或习惯时，动词用原形；主语是 he/she/it 时动词加 s 或 es。

examples.en: They help me see you better.
examples.zh: 它们帮我更好地看见你。

examples.en: They help me hear you better.
examples.zh: 它们帮我更好地听见你。

grammar.pattern: A is + 形容词比较级 + than B
grammar.rule: 比较两样东西时，用 形容词比较级 + than，比如 heavier than, stronger than。

examples.en: Bricks are heavier than straw and sticks.
Brick houses are stronger than straw houses and stick houses.
examples.zh: 砖房比稻草房和树枝房坚固。

grammar.point: 情态动词 can 表请求
grammar.rule: 用 Can I please ...? 礼貌地请求做某事，用 Can you ...? 请求别人做某事。

examples.en: Pete: Can I please buy your straw?
examples.zh: 皮特：我可以买你的稻草吗？

examples.en: Pat: Can I please buy your sticks?
examples.zh: 帕特：我可以买你的树枝吗？

examples.en: Paul: Can I please buy your bricks?
examples.zh: 保罗：我可以买你的砖吗？

examples.en: Wolf: Can you hear the sweet little birds?
examples.zh: 狼：你能听到那些甜美的小鸟吗？

grammar.rule: 用 Don't + 动词原形 表示不要做某事，用来提醒或禁止。

examples.en: Mother: Don't run off the path.
Mother: Don't go into the woods.
Mother: Don't forget to say "Good morning!" to your grandmother.
examples.zh: 妈妈：别忘了跟奶奶说“早上好！”

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 → 过去式（如 go → went, have → had）
grammar.rule: 有些动词变过去式时不按规则加 -ed，要单独记住它们的过去式形式。

passages.text:
Some families are small. Some are big.
Families are different, but family love is the same.
This is my mum.
And this is my dad.
passages.zh: 有些家庭很小，有些家庭很大。家庭各不相同，但家人的爱是一样的。这是我的妈妈。这是我的爸爸。

passages.name: Reading time
passages.text:
This is my family.
I play with my brothers.
I share with my sisters.
I talk with my cousins.
We listen with care.
I have a big family.
I love my big family.
Families can be big or small.
Family members love each other.
passages.zh: 这是我的家庭。我和兄弟们一起玩。我和姐妹们分享。我和表兄弟姐妹们交谈。我们用心倾听。我有一个大家庭。我爱我的大家庭。家庭可以大也可以小。家人彼此相爱。

We eat a lot.

我知道！我们唱歌！
熊猫也吃很多。
我们吃很多。

passages.name: Reading time
passages.text:
I am an apple tree.
My new family help me.
I need air, water and sun. My family water me.
It is cold. They help me.
I am big now. I give apples to my family. We are all happy!
My family like me.
I love the fresh air.
The flowers are so beautiful!
passages.zh: 我是一棵苹果树。我的新家人帮助我。我需要空气、水和阳光。我的家人给我浇水。天气很冷，他们帮助我。我现在长大了。我把苹果送给我的家人。我们都很开心！我的家人喜欢我。我喜欢新鲜的空气。花儿真美！
passages.topic: 苹果树与家人互相帮助

passages.name: I am a sunflower
passages.text:
I am a sunflower. I am
tall and green.
Now I am a big
yellow flower. Bees
come. They are
yellow and black.
I give them food.
Then I am green
and yellow.
Now it is cold. I am
green and brown.
I am gone. But my
children grow.
passages.zh:
我是一朵向日葵。我
又高又绿。
现在我是一朵大大的
黄色花朵。蜜蜂
来了。它们
是黄色和黑色的。
我给它们食物。
然后我变成绿色
和黄色。
现在天气冷了。我
是绿色和棕色。
我消失了。但我的
孩子们长大了。
keypoints: 一般现在时 I am / They are
形容词描述 tall and green

passages.name: Reading time
passages.text:
Hi! I'm Ra.
Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too.
Zoom, look!
This book is so cool!
Wow!
We're from China.
Hello! I'm Zip.
What's your name?
Welcome to Russia!
Where are you from?
What a trip!
What fun!
East or west, home is best!
Bear, who's that?
That's my neighbour, Beaver.
Look! Pandas!
We're back in China!
passages.zh: 嗨！我是Ra。很高兴见到你。我也很高兴见到你。Zoom，看！这本书太酷了！哇！我们来自中国。你好！我是Zip。你叫什么名字？欢迎来到俄罗斯！你从哪里来？多么棒的旅行啊！多么有趣啊！无论东方还是西方，家是最好的地方！Bear，那是谁？那是我的邻居，Beaver。看！熊猫！我们回到中国了！
passages.topic: 介绍新朋友、国家与旅行

passages.name: Reading time
passages.text:
We like fruit. We can have fun with fruit.
We can make animals with fruit.
We have friends.
We can make fruit friends too.
We can act as fruit.
We can be tall or short.
We can be fat or thin.
We can also "write" with fruit.
We can express our ideas in different ways!
It is fun!
passages.zh: 我们喜欢水果。我们可以用水果玩得开心。我们可以用水果做动物。我们有朋友。我们也可以做水果朋友。我们可以扮演水果。我们可以高也可以矮。我们可以胖也可以瘦。我们还可以用水果“写字”。我们可以用不同的方式表达我们的想法！这很有趣！
keypoints: 情态动词 can 表能力
动词短语 make animals, act as
表达想法 express our ideas

passages.name: Reading time
passages.text:
We learn from Mum and Dad. Polar bears do the same.
We play and learn. Lions do the same.
We taste food with our tongues. Frogs get food with their tongues.
We speak and learn. Ants can't speak. But they can use smell to learn.
We draw maps with pencils and paper. Bees can't draw. But they can make a "map".
Eagles can see a rabbit from the sky. We can't. But we can use tools to see more!
passages.zh:
我们从爸爸妈妈那里学习。北极熊也是这样。
我们边玩边学。狮子也是这样。
我们用舌头品尝食物。青蛙用舌头获取食物。
我们说话并学习。蚂蚁不会说话。但它们可以用嗅觉来学习。
我们用铅笔和纸画地图。蜜蜂不会画。但它们可以制作一张“地图”。
鹰能从空中看到兔子。我们不能。但我们可以用工具看得更多！
keypoints: 比较结构 do the same

passages.name: Read and write
passages.text:
What helps you learn?
I can hear with my ears.
I can see with my eyes.
I can smell with my nose.
I can touch with my hands.
I can use a bag, a book, paper, a pen, a pencil and a ruler to learn.
Can I use your eraser, please?
What are these? They're grapes.
passages.zh:
什么帮助你学习？
我可以用耳朵听。
我可以用眼睛看。
我可以用鼻子闻。
我可以用手触摸。
我可以用书包、书、纸、钢笔、铅笔和尺子来学习。
请问我可以用你的橡皮吗？
这些是什么？它们是葡萄。
keypoints: 礼貌请求 Can I use your ..., please?
passages.writing: What helps you learn? I can ... with my ... . I can use a ..., a ... and some ... to learn. Can I use your ..., please? What are these? They're ... .

passages.text:

You can try!
Healthy food.
How about nuts?
OK.

Nuts, vegetables, meat, flowers ... What's healthy food?
Eat what's good for you. But you also need to exercise!

你可以试试！

好的。
Zoom，你想吃点肉吗？
它很健康。
我吃的花。它们也很美味又健康。
坚果、蔬菜、肉、花……什么是健康的食物？
吃对你有益的食物。但你也需要锻炼！

passages.name: Read and write
passages.text:
OK.
Have some vegetables and fruit, John.
Your plate is not healthy, John.
Whose plate is healthy? Look and say.
passages.zh:
好的。
约翰，吃点蔬菜和水果吧。
约翰，你的餐盘不健康。
谁的餐盘是健康的？看一看，说一说。

passages.name: Where is my boat?
passages.text:
Where is my boat?
Is it in this box? Wow!
My old robot!
Oh no! My robot has one arm, one eye and one foot.
I need some help.
Hi, Cat! Do you have any old toys? I need an arm for my robot.
Nice!
Thank you.
I have an old doll's arm.
Hi, Tiger! Do you have any old toys? I need an eye for my robot.
I have an old car.
You can use the light!
I also need a foot for my robot.
How about this?
That works!
Look at my robot now!
Wow!
passages.zh:
我的船在哪里？
它在这个盒子里吗？哇！
我的旧机器人！
哦不！我的机器人只有一只手臂、一只眼睛和一只脚。
我需要一些帮助。
嗨，猫！你有一些旧玩具吗？我需要一只手臂给我的机器人。
太好了！
谢谢。
我有一只旧娃娃的手臂。
嗨，老虎！你有一些旧玩具吗？我需要一只眼睛给我的机器人。
我有一辆旧汽车。
你可以用那个灯！
我还需要一只脚给我的机器人。
这个怎么样？
可以！
看看我的机器人现在怎么样！
哇！

passages.name: Read and write
passages.text:
I have some old cars and boats.
They are still good. I put them on the shelves.

passages.text:
Numbers are useful. And numbers are interesting too.
A clock has twelve numbers.
We use them to tell the time.
And a year has twelve months!
How many eggs do we have?
Twelve.
In a mobile phone number, how many numbers are there?
And a football team always has eleven players.
A player can get a red card!
That's true. Then the team only has ten players!
No, eleven.
That's not true!
Oh, how so?
Twelve?

We are community helpers. We
often help children and old people.

passages.name: Dad's postcard to John
passages.text:
Hi, John!
How are you? I'm in a big park in Sydney
today. It's hot and sunny here. It's fun to go
to the park with my new friends. We play
basketball together. Their children swim
in the pool. How about you? Is it cold and
windy in Beijing? Can you fly your kite?
Love,
Dad
passages.zh:
嗨，约翰！
你好吗？我今天在悉尼的一个大公园里。
这里又热又晴朗。和新朋友们一起去公园很有趣。
我们一起打篮球。他们的孩子在游泳池里游泳。
你呢？北京又冷又有风吗？你能放风筝吗？
爱你的，
爸爸

passages.name: Colourful seasons, colourful life!
passages.text:
Spring is green.
It's full of life.
I take many walks,
And fly my kite.
Summer is blue.
I play games and sing songs,
Wear dresses and T-shirts.
The days are so long.
Autumn is orange.
I like the falling leaves.
I wear sweaters and shirts,
And enjoy mooncakes.
Winter is white.
I make snowmen with friends,
Wear warm coats and gloves.
Then spring comes again.
passages.zh:
春天是绿色的。
它充满生机。
我常去散步，
还放风筝。
夏天是蓝色的。
我玩游戏、唱歌，
穿连衣裙和T恤。
白天很长。
秋天是橙色的。
我喜欢落叶。
我穿毛衣和衬衫，
还吃月饼。
冬天是白色的。
我和朋友堆雪人，
穿暖和的大衣和手套。
然后春天又来了。

passages.name: Helping hands in class
passages.text:
Helping hands in class
We have some class rules. We put up our hands to speak. We turn off the lights after school. When we don't understand, we say, "Excuse me?"
We also have some jobs. Some of us make wall newspapers. Some of us keep our classroom clean and tidy. Some hand out the workbooks. We all help make our classroom great!
passages.zh:
课堂上的帮手
我们有一些课堂规则。我们举手发言。放学后我们关灯。当我们不明白时，我们说："打扰一下？"
我们还有一些任务。我们中的一些人制作墙报。一些人保持教室干净整洁。一些人分发练习本。我们都帮助让我们的教室变得很棒！

Dad, I love the red bike.
Can I save up my money and buy it?

Wow! It's the red bike!
You work hard and often help Mum and me. This is our special gift for you.
Thank you so much, Dad!
I will, Dad. Thanks.
I still have all this money.

passages.name: Miss White's note
passages.text:
Dear students,
Our New Year's party is next Monday. I can see you are all
very excited. I am too. I have some tips for you:
1. Plan your time well.
You need to prepare for the party. There will also be tests
on Wednesday and Friday. You are very hard-working, but don't
forget to rest.
2. Stay healthy.
It is flu season. You should get enough sleep. You should also
eat healthy food and drink enough water.
3. Don't be afraid to ask for help.
If you have any problems, don't worry. Everyone has problems.
You can always talk to your parents, and you can ask me for help
too.
Yours,
Miss White

现在是流感季节。你应该睡足觉。你也应该吃健康的食物、喝足够的水。

如果你有任何问题，别担心。每个人都有问题。你总是可以和父母谈谈，也可以向我求助。
你的，
怀特老师

Dear Mike,

What can I do? Can you help me?
Yours,
Jim
Dear Jim,
Don't feel sad. You can . You can also . It is OK to feel bad sometimes. It is always good to share your feelings.
Yours,
Mike

passages.name: Welcome to River Nature Park
passages.text:
Welcome to River Nature Park
There are many rivers and big trees here.
There are a lot of fish in the rivers. You can go boating on the river with your friends.
There is heavy rain in summer. Sometimes there are floods too. Check the weather report before you go.

comprehension.q: There are many rivers and big trees here.

There is heavy rain in summer. Sometimes there are floods too. Check the weather report before you go.

passages.name: Welcome to Mountain Nature Park
passages.text:
Welcome to Mountain Nature Park
There are many mountains, and there is a big forest. It is a great place to hike or walk your dog.
There is often heavy fog on spring mornings. Don't go into the forest then. In autumn, it is often windy. Be careful of fires.
passages.zh: 欢迎来到山地自然公园。这里有许多山，还有一片大森林。这是一个徒步或遛狗的好地方。春天早晨经常有大雾。那时不要进入森林。秋天经常刮风。小心火灾。

comprehension.q: There are many mountains, and there is a big forest. It is a great place to hike or walk your dog.
There is often heavy fog on spring mornings. Don't go into the forest then. In autumn, it is often windy. Be careful of fires.

passages.name: Robinson's letter
passages.text:
My name is Robinson. I live on an island. I always get up early every day. I wash my face, and then I eat breakfast. Sometimes I clean my cave, too.
I often go swimming in the water. In the afternoon, I play sports with my friend. His name is Friday.
Friday is good at sports. He often wins.
passages.zh:
我叫鲁滨逊。我住在一个岛上。我每天总是很早起床。我洗脸，然后吃早餐。有时我也打扫我的山洞。
我经常在水里游泳。下午，我和我的朋友一起做运动。他的名字叫星期五。
星期五擅长运动。他经常赢。

comprehension.q: Robinson and Friday always get up late in the morning.

passages.name: The Four Seasons
passages.text:
Spring is green with flowers and songs.
Summer is hot and the days are long.
Autumn is golden and farmers are busy.
Winter is white and the year is gone.

春天是绿色的，有花和歌声。
夏天很热，白天很长。
秋天是金色的，农民们很忙。
冬天是白色的，一年过去了。

passages.text:
Look at the green trees and pink flowers.
The weather is hot, hot, hot!
What lovely colours! The leaves fall and fall and fall. I love fall!
There is lots of snow. It is white everywhere.
I like spring because there are beautiful flowers everywhere.
Wow! I want to paint a picture, too!
I like winter because I can play in the snow.
I like summer, but I can't swim.
Robin likes them all!

passages.name: Liu Jia's letter and story
passages.text:
Liu Jia was crying. So Miss White asked her, "What's the matter, Liu Jia? You look sad."
Liu Jia answered, "I'm feeling down. My good friend Lucy moved to another city."
Miss White listened carefully and told Liu Jia, "Think about happy things. Call your friend or send her some emails."
"I tried that, but I still feel unhappy," said Liu Jia.
Miss White gave her a glass of water.
"Maybe you can do some exercise. Exercise may cheer you up!"
"Join some after-school clubs and make new friends! You can talk and have fun with them," added Miss White.
"I will try. Thank you, Miss White," said Liu Jia.
Dear Miss White,
I often make video calls with my friend now.
I also joined a ping-pong club and made some new friends. I feel much better. Thank you so much!
Liu Jia

passages.name: Our winner
passages.text:
The winner is my good friend,
Chen Jie. She's a 12-year-old
girl from Class One, Grade Six.

Chen Jie has her special way to manage money. She writes a
spending plan every Sunday. Every week, she gets her pocket money.
She also gets some money from selling old things. She keeps her
money in three money jars. Jar 1 is money to spend. She uses this
money to buy goods, like books. She also uses it to pay
for services, like haircuts. Jar 2 is money to share. She
uses this money to buy gifts, for example, birthday
gifts for her family. Jar 3 is money to save. Chen Jie
puts money there to save up for big things, like a new
bike. She really manages her money well!
passages.zh:
获奖者是我好朋友陈洁。她是六年级一班的12岁女孩。

陈洁有她管理金钱的特殊方法。她每个星期天写一份消费计划。每周，她都会得到零花钱。她还通过卖旧物得到一些钱。她把钱放在三个存钱罐里。1号罐是用于消费的钱。她用这笔钱买商品，比如书。她也用它支付服务费用，比如理发。2号罐是用于分享的钱。她用这笔钱买礼物，例如给家人的生日礼物。3号罐是用于储蓄的钱。陈洁把钱放进去，为买大件物品存钱，比如一辆新自行车。她真的把钱管理得很好！

passages.name: In space
passages.text:
Chinese astronauts are called taikonauts. Their life in space is special.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning. But getting ready in space is different. They can't use water to wash their faces. So taikonauts have to use a wet cloth. They brush their teeth with a special toothpaste and have to "eat" it!
Each day the taikonauts are very busy. They do a lot of work. For example, they grow vegetables and rice. Sometimes, they also give classes to children and answer questions about space.
It is hard work. The taikonauts must stay healthy. Every afternoon they do exercise to keep healthy and strong. But their job is also very interesting. They can see the sunrise and sunset 16 times a day. The view is amazing! There is no other job like this one.
passages.zh:
中国航天员被称为“太空人”。他们在太空中的生活很特别。
太空人早上很早起床。但在太空中做准备是不同的。他们不能用水洗脸，所以太空人必须用湿布。他们用一种特殊的牙膏刷牙，而且必须把牙膏“吃”掉！
太空人每天都很忙。他们做很多工作。例如，他们种植蔬菜和稻米。有时，他们还会给孩子们上课，并回答关于太空的问题。
这是一项艰苦的工作。太空人必须保持健康。每天下午他们都做运动以保持健康和强壮。但他们的工作也非常有趣。他们一天可以看到16次日出和日落。景色令人惊叹！没有别的工作像这样。

passages.name: Green Energy
passages.text:
Green Energy
What green energy do you know?
Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy.
How do we use it?
We use green energy to light, heat and cool our homes and schools.
We also use it to run cars, buses and trains.
Many resources will run out. How can we save energy?
We should follow the "3R" rules. We can reduce energy use, reuse things, and recycle old clothes, toys and books.
passages.zh:
绿色能源
你知道哪些绿色能源？
风能、太阳能和水能都是绿色能源的类型。
我们如何使用它？
我们用绿色能源来照明、取暖和冷却我们的家与学校。
我们也用它来驱动汽车、公交车和火车。
许多资源将会耗尽。我们如何节约能源？
我们应该遵循“3R”规则。我们可以减少能源使用、重复利用物品，并回收旧衣服、玩具和书籍。

passages.text:
I go to school from Monday to Friday.
My favourite day is Monday.
In English class, I read many English stories, and I like to speak English with my friends.
On Monday I have maths, English, music and PE. I like PE best.
I play the piano or sing songs in music class. This is very noisy and often great fun.
Maths is my first class. I often answer maths questions. Sometimes they're difficult.
In the afternoon I have PE class. I sometimes play football or exercise in the gym. I'm not good at running, but I like football best!
passages.zh: 我从周一到周五上学。我最喜欢的一天是周一。在英语课上，我读很多英语故事，我喜欢和朋友们说英语。周一我有数学、英语、音乐和体育课。我最喜欢体育。在音乐课上，我弹钢琴或唱歌。这很吵，但常常很有趣。数学是我的第一节课。我经常回答数学问题。有时候它们很难。下午我有体育课。我有时踢足球或在体育馆锻炼。我不擅长跑步，但我最喜欢足球！

passages.name: A farewell party
passages.text:
Dear Friends,
It is time to leave our school. We are all going to middle school soon, so we will say goodbye to each other. We are going to have a farewell party. You can bring your friends.
Place: Our music room     Time: Friday  3 p.m.
Activities:
We will draw pictures and sing songs. We are going to give prizes for the best pictures. We are going to have cake, candy and juice, too. Yum!
We will also give many prizes to our good students. For example, who helped others the most? Who studied hard? Who wrote the best story?
We will listen to music, play games and dance. It will be great fun.
See you at the party!
passages.zh: 亲爱的朋友们，是时候离开我们的学校了。我们很快都要上中学了，所以我们将互相道别。我们将举办一个告别派对。你可以带上你的朋友。地点：我们的音乐室 时间：周五下午3点。活动：我们将画画和唱歌。我们将为最好的画颁发奖品。我们还将有蛋糕、糖果和果汁。美味！我们还将给我们的优秀学生颁发许多奖品。例如，谁帮助了别人最多？谁学习最努力？谁写了最好的故事？我们将听音乐、玩游戏和跳舞。这将非常有趣。派对上见！

Little Duck is watching the sun

lower, but his shadow is getting
longer and longer.

his friend Old Tree. "You are
older and smarter than me. Tell
me — why is my shadow longer
when the sun gets lower?"
Old Tree says,
"That’s easy, Little
Duck. The sun goes

we grow older every
day. Your shadow
grows longer because
you are growing taller.
You are becoming a big
beautiful bird!"

passages.name: Dear Sir
passages.text:
Dear Sir,
Our weekend at your hotel was bad. Our room was big but everything was very old. Our friend Robin cleaned our room and fixed a broken chair.
My mother wanted to read a book but the lamp was too small.
My dad got some hamburgers from the hotel kitchen, but they were cold and tasted bad.
I wanted to watch TV but the TV didn’t work. The people in Room 301 listened to loud music. I didn’t sleep all night.
I’m sorry, but we didn’t enjoy our stay very much.
Wu Binbin and family

我们在你们酒店的周末过得很糟糕。我们的房间很大，但一切都非常旧。我们的朋友罗宾打扫了我们的房间，还修好了一把坏椅子。
我妈妈想看书，但灯太小了。
我爸爸从酒店厨房拿了一些汉堡，但它们很冷，味道也不好。
我想看电视，但电视坏了。301 房间的人听了很吵的音乐。我一整晚都没睡。
很抱歉，我们不太享受这次住宿。

passages.name: Wu Binbin's diary
passages.text:
Saturday, April 23rd
Today was a sunny day. In the morning, we rode a bike for three people. Max sat in a basket on the front of the bike.
That was fun! We took pictures of the beautiful countryside.
We bought some gifts and ate some delicious food.
In the afternoon, Mum ate some bad fruit and didn’t feel well. So we stayed in the hotel. Dad and I wanted to make her happy. We dressed up and made a funny play. Robin played the part of a dog. He was so cute. Max liked him so much. He jumped on him and licked him. Of course, Robin didn’t like it.
We laughed and laughed.
It was a bad day but also a good day!
passages.zh:
4月23日，星期六
今天是晴天。早上，我们骑了一辆三人自行车。马克斯坐在自行车前面的篮子里。
那很有趣！我们拍了美丽乡村的照片。
我们买了一些礼物，吃了一些美味的食物。
下午，妈妈吃了一些坏水果，感觉不舒服。所以我们待在酒店里。爸爸和我想让她开心。我们穿上戏服，演了一出有趣的戏。罗宾扮演了一只狗。他太可爱了。马克斯非常喜欢他。他跳到他身上舔他。当然，罗宾不喜欢这样。
我们笑个不停。
这是糟糕的一天，但也是美好的一天！

passages.name: What a dream!
passages.text:
Wu Binbin had a race with his father and Max. There were many people there. His father ran very fast, but Wu Binbin could not.
There was nothing he could do. He was so worried. "I could run fast at school," he thought. "Why am I so slow now?"
Then Robin said, "Drink this!" and gave Wu Binbin some water. Wu Binbin drank it and suddenly he felt good. He could run fast again.
There was a second race. There were many animals in that race.
Wu Binbin ran like a cheetah. He could win the race! But suddenly he tripped and fell. Then he woke up. He was in bed. It was all a dream!
passages.zh: 吴彬彬和爸爸还有马克赛跑。那里有很多人。爸爸跑得很快，但吴彬彬跑不快。他什么也做不了，非常担心。他想：“我在学校能跑得很快，为什么现在这么慢？”然后罗宾说：“喝这个！”并给了吴彬彬一些水。吴彬彬喝了水，突然感觉很好，又能跑得很快了。第二场比赛开始了，那场比赛里有很多动物。吴彬彬像猎豹一样奔跑，他能赢得比赛！但突然他绊倒摔了一跤。然后他醒了，他在床上。原来这全是一场梦！

turns.speaker: Mrs Green

turns.zh: 太棒了！小小的改变可以带来很大的不同。
